name: Little Land Nursery and Montessori Centre
headline: Little Land Nursery & Montessori Centre
lede: From humble beginnings, Little Land Nursery has grown into one of Dubai’s most trusted and beloved Montessori nurseries.
about: Little land Nursery is by far the best Nursery we have seen in the UAE. The growth shown by our son during his tenure there has been amazing and tangible. The teachers are great and they treat each and every child there with the utmost love and care. There is a very nice feel to the place and lots of warmth and love to go around.

From humble beginnings, Little Land has grown into one of Dubai’s most trusted and beloved Montessori nurseries. Our passionate team of qualified educators is dedicated to nurturing each child’s unique journey.
